title: Fix the Continue-Before-Increment Bug
description: The program should print odd numbers from 1 to 9.
actualProblem: When i is even, continue jumps straight back to the while condition check — skipping the i++ statement entirely. Since i never changes on even values, the loop gets stuck forever on the first even number it hits.
explanation: continue skips the rest of the loop body for that iteration, including any code meant to update the loop variable. Any increment that must always happen needs to run before the continue, not after it.
